notes: Single pipeline but five exact-format deliverable files must all hold simultaneously (value file, label-per-line result.txt, exact-column result.csv, fixed-width report with headline/flags/objective/top-10, JPEG output). IPv4 regex must reject leading-zero and out-of-range octets and refuse to match inside longer alphanumeric tokens; hidden logs plant those adversarial decoys. Difficulty comes from the adversarial-input and hidden-case generalization dimensions (medium floor for the IPv4-octet competency).
